//: Deliberately NOT a member of the root solution tsconfig.json, and deliberately NOT extending tsconfig.base.json. The base is NodeNext with `lib: ["ES2023"]` and no DOM; this is a browser bundle that vite compiles, so it needs DOM libs, `jsx: react-jsx`, and bundler resolution for its ~90 extensionless relative specifiers. It also has nothing to emit, and a composite project may not set `noEmit` (TS6304) — hence a standalone config rather than an override. Nothing imports this package as a module, so no `references` point here.
